about_the_game:
About This Game

Only Up: Snow is a demanding single-player parkour adventure where every step, jump, and climb matters. Designed to test your patience, focus, and agility, this game challenges you to rise higher and higher — with nothing but your determination keeping you from falling back to the start.

You begin your journey in a snowy, frozen landscape, surrounded by ice and silence. But the climb doesn’t stop there. As you progress, the world changes — from slippery, snow-covered areas to towering skyscrapers, narrow ledges, and unstable platforms high above the city. The higher you go, the greater the risk, and the more satisfying every step forward becomes.

Every mistake has consequences. One wrong move can undo minutes — or even hours — of progress. There are no checkpoints to save you, no shortcuts to the top. All you have is your skill, your timing, and your determination to reach the summit.

Key Features

  • Challenging Single-Player Parkour – A true test of patience, reflexes, and consistency.

  • Snowy Beginning – Start your climb in a frozen, icy environment that sets the tone for the journey ahead.

  • Dynamic Environments – Progress from snowy landscapes into massive skyscrapers and tricky city structures.

  • High Stakes Gameplay – Every fall sends you back to the beginning, making every move intense and meaningful.

  • Atmospheric Journey – Feel the shift from cold silence to dizzying heights as you climb higher and higher.

  • Replayability – Each attempt teaches you new paths, tricks, and strategies to climb faster and further.

Will you conquer the summit, or will the climb defeat you?
